comment: cfgfiles.c parse_conf_buf() and handle_config_section(). CHOOSE=lantern picks section [lantern]; inside it, an empty CHOOSE= frees gc.config_section_chosen, choose_random_part("") returns NULL and config_error_add() reports 'No config section to choose' while gc.config_section_current stays 'lantern'. The following OPTIONS=time line therefore takes the 'current section but nothing chosen' skip (cfgfiles.c:575-577), so the status line shows no T: field. Return dismisses the error, then the Valkyrie searches. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
